name: Komnata Vzgljadov
source:
In this small mod, you will find both romance and mysticism, a little drama, and all this with familiar heroes and heroines.

Or not. In reality, this mod is satirical in nature, showing the paucity of plots and stylistic devices that we are given again and again.
translation:
In this small mod, you will find both romance and mysticism, a little drama, and all this with familiar heroes and heroines.

Or not. In reality, this mod is satirical in nature, showing the paucity of plots and stylistic devices that we are given again and again.
